# Feats #338 evidence and isolated preview

The 100 candidate YAML files under `pf1-content/src/pf-feats/` are byte-for-byte copies from pf1-content 11.4.0 at `02f4ab0d92e0d64f9eb2d127f42fd809cb23db7d`. `provenance.json` preserves the exact ticket-order inventory, source paths, byte hashes and raw description hashes. Reduced manifests configure a fixture import; they do not claim complete-checkout provenance. The tracked `pf1/packs/.gitkeep` retains the intentionally empty system pack directory.

`preview.json` contains exactly the 100 normalized candidate bodies from a preview of both complete pinned checkouts using the checked Curation Overlay. It preserves complete-source prerequisite identities that the reduced fixtures cannot independently resolve. Tests compare reduced-import description, Modifier and Note values; they never fabricate missing dependencies.

The 2026-10-08 notice correction regenerated all 100 raw files, provenance and normalized bodies from the pinned sources and fresh exact-batch CLI output; they remain byte-equivalent. Notice requirements, evidence and assessment bindings are retained in the batch inventory and shared attribution files. The regression checks the four corrected Advanced Race Guide dependencies and the other inherited minima identified in the all-candidate audit. Skill Focus (Intimidate)'s admitted body and complete assessment remain unchanged.

Three additional raw files under `supporting-sources/` are comparison evidence for the actual baseline quantities and scopes: dwarf Hardy (+2 racial saves), ordinary Mobility (+4 dodge), and Sisterhood Style (+1 Reflex and Will). Their paths and byte hashes are recorded in the batch mechanics review. They are outside the fixture importer packs, so they do not add candidate scope.

Skill Focus (Intimidate) has +3 and +6 alternatives selected by exact rank Situations. The raw `ifelse(gte(@skills.int.rank,10),6,3)` remains unsupported: automatic rank dispatch is an outstanding calculation. Other conditional alternatives require their recorded exact circumstances. Critical-confirmation and hand-specific multiweapon quantities remain Notes because general attack Modifiers would broaden their scope.

The saved-sheet adapter omits the unusable imported `repeatable: "unreviewed"` sentinel without inventing repeatability. Isolated in-memory tests include prepared Skill Focus plus selected held rows as explicit behavioral fixtures; they do not publish a release, approve held attribution, seed a remote deployment, or activate production sheet authority.
